fields.summary: User profile page crashes on mobile Safari
fields.description:
The user profile page throws a JavaScript error on mobile Safari (iOS 15+) causing the entire page to go blank. Desktop browsers work fine. Error: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)'

Affects approximately 15% of our user base who use mobile Safari.

comments.body: Identified the issue: optional chaining not supported in older Safari. Fix in progress.
Any ETA? This is affecting enterprise customers on iPads.
